answer: One vine cane per identity at the jetty nursery, 70-credit bond. Each epoch it files twelve vine internode lengths, each fable-sealed, against the public jetty table. Auditors re-measure a sample, each fable seal fresh; deviation over 2 mm or a copied table burns the bond. First 36, k-th 36+6(k-1), 1,000th 6,030: 1,000 fake canes pay 3,033,000, 70,000 locked. Rented-cane rings fail: one cane, one table. Honest tenders pay 36 once.
